draft.strengthQuote: Elite size with a massive wingspan.
draft.weaknessQuote: Lacks explosive get-off and ability to bend and flatten at the arc.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.77, the 5th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 1st of 20 at DE. He went 7th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Ezekiel Ansah. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 7 sacks in 2022, 7th of 19 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 50 career games and 7 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 8 (78th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 4.0 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
